notes:
Lead profile: early-stage B2B SaaS building an embedded in-app assistant for mid-market SaaS products. Goal is lightweight contextual assistant inside their web app (customer-facing help + inline suggestions). They signed up self-serve and have a small dev team experimenting.

What they told us: "Streaming is a must—UX needs partial-token streaming start under ~100ms; overall p95 <300ms end-to-end." High sensitivity to UI latency; willing to trade higher model size for better responsiveness.

Technical summary: prefer hosted API for now (no infra team to manage Dedicated/Private). Primary integration via browser->backend->Redwood streaming path (WebSocket). Estimated average concurrent users: 40-120 during peak; expect bursts to 300+ (sales demo spikes). Messages are short (prompt+context ~150-400 tokens typical), prefer continuous/kv caching suggestions.

Security/compliance: small legal/procurement team asked about SOC2 and SSO. They want simple SAML SSO for admin console access and audit logs for billing events. Data residency not required at this stage.

Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; looking for predictable per-token pricing and quick tips to reduce per-query cost (suggested batching/caching).

Quotes/attitude: "We want something that just works in a week and doesn't tank UX." Friendly, pragmatic engineering-first buyer (CTO + 2 devs leading POC).

Open items / next actions: send streaming quickstart sample (node/browser), include note on p95 latency tuning and recommended models/quantization profiles for lowest latency.
